escenas.texto: Over four hundred and five million views. Thirty videos. The biggest continent on the planet, and this week, a twenty second Short is about to outrun channels with tens of millions of subscribers. This is Top 10 Social Media, the Asia edition. Three countdowns: the most viewed, the most commented and the most liked videos of the week. Real numbers, from ten to one, and the top of each podium stays secret until its moment. Let's go.

The rules, quick and clear. Only videos posted in the last seven days that trended in Asia. One video per creator on each list. Music and news have their own space. Every number comes from the official YouTube API, measured at this week's cut-off. No guesses. Just data.

Countdown number one: the ten most viewed. And look at the entry ticket. Number ten, from India, Dangal TV Channel, with full episode three hundred and seventy-two of its series Rimjhim. Over fourteen million views, from a channel with sixty-six point six million subscribers. Fourteen million just to get in the door. Welcome to Asia.

Number nine, Sony Sports Network, with seventeen minutes of cricket highlights: Sanju Samson's sixty-seven in the first T-twenty International. Over fourteen million views, and over one thousand six hundred comments.

At number eight, from Indonesia, Keizo and Friends. A thirty-three second Short, over fourteen million views and over one hundred and eighty-two thousand likes, from a channel with nine point nine million subscribers.

Number seven, from India, Sonakshi Sinha, with “When he thinks he's helping, but YouTube got there first”. A fifty-six second Short, over fifteen million views and over two thousand two hundred comments.
At number six, back to Indonesia. Aletha Abew, a channel with seventeen million subscribers, and a forty-one second Short. Over sixteen million views.
Number five, from India, Kitchen CureAI, with a three minute Diwali special. Over eighteen million views. And from here, the numbers climb past twenty million.

Number four, from South Korea, DoubleBite, with “Water vs Dried Fish”. Fifty-nine seconds, over twenty-two million views and over three hundred and eleven thousand likes. The only Korean channel on this list, and it nearly made the podium.

The podium. Bronze medal, from India, JAI HIND OFFICIAL. A twenty-five second Short with over twenty-two million views, from a channel of about one hundred and thirty-seven thousand subscribers. Small channel, giant reach.

Silver medal, from India, Facts' Mine, with “This Flying Car Mocks Elon Musk's New Tesla Roadster”. Over twenty-four million views and over six hundred and eighty-five thousand likes, for a thirty-nine second Short. Nineteen point three million subscribers behind it. And yet, it's not number one.

Here it is. Number one most viewed in Asia: from India, Shivapriya Official, with “Mango leaf decoration ideas for Diwali”. Over forty-seven million views. Almost double the silver medal. A twenty second Short, from a channel of about one hundred and thirty-three thousand subscribers. The festival of lights, and the brightest number of the week.

Now we change the scoreboard. Views say who watched. Comments say who had something to say. Countdown number two: the ten most commented. Number ten, from Indonesia, JKT48, with the music video for Ayo Senyumlah. Over four thousand six hundred comments, and over four hundred and twenty-nine thousand views.
Number nine, from the United Arab Emirates, Esraa Gaming, playing Poppy Playtime Chapter 2 for seventy-two minutes. Over six thousand three hundred comments.
At number eight, from Pakistan, Top Pakistani Dramas, with episode twenty-four of Dar-e-Nijaat. Over six thousand six hundred comments, and over eight point eight million views.
Number seven, from Indonesia, Nadia Omara, with part three hundred and ninety-nine of BIOSKOP. Over eight thousand two hundred comments, and over eight million views.
At number six, from Japan, Ado, with “Patient A”. Over eight thousand seven hundred comments, and over one point five million views. Japan enters the countdown.
Number five, from Iraq, Atro, with twenty-five minutes of PUBG Mobile. Over eight thousand nine hundred comments, from a channel with sixteen point three million subscribers.
At number four, from India, Shivang Mini, with “I Became the Richest Player in Roblox Steal an Egg”. Over nine thousand one hundred comments. And now, we cross the ten thousand line.
Bronze medal in comments, from India, Techno Gamerz, a channel with fifty-three point four million subscribers. One hundred and one minutes of First Light gameplay, and over ten thousand comments.

Silver medal, and the surprise of this list. The Arabic-language channel Lana and Roro, with an eighteen minute video. Over twelve thousand comments, with only over six hundred and seventy-two thousand views. Nearly two comments for every hundred views. But number one plays in another league.

Number one most commented in Asia: from Indonesia, Dhot Design, with part five of “Aku Masih Di Sini”. Over twenty-three thousand comments. Twenty-three thousand. Far ahead of everyone else, with over nine point three million views and twenty-three point seven million subscribers behind it.
And the final countdown: the ten most liked. The purest vote of approval. At number ten, from Indonesia, Nadia Omara, again. Over two hundred and nine thousand likes.
Number nine, from Indonesia, Dhot Design, our champion of comments. Over two hundred and fourteen thousand likes.
At number eight, from India, Dangal TV Channel, now with full episode three hundred and seventy-four of Rimjhim. Over two hundred and twenty-five thousand likes, and over thirteen million views.
Number seven, from Indonesia, Kurang 1 Menit. A thirty-one second Short with over two hundred and thirty-five thousand likes.
At number six, from the United Arab Emirates, Priya and Sid, with “UNLIMITED chocolate at the Lindt Factory!”. Over two hundred and seventy-six thousand likes.
Number five, from South Korea, DoubleBite, with “Water vs Dried Fish”. Over three hundred and eleven thousand likes.

At number four, from India, Shivapriya Official, our champion of views. Over three hundred and fourteen thousand likes. The most watched video of the week, and only fourth in likes. So who's above it?
Bronze medal in likes, Indu kanchan Singh, with a three minute video. Over four hundred and forty-four thousand likes, from a channel of about one hundred and sixteen thousand subscribers.
Silver medal, from India, Facts' Mine, with the flying car. Over six hundred and eighty-five thousand likes. Silver in views, silver in likes. But someone got even more.

Number one most liked in Asia: from Indonesia, isonkeh, with a thirty-three second Short. Over seven hundred and thirty thousand likes, on over eight point five million views. That's more than eight likes for every hundred views, from a channel of about five hundred and fourteen thousand subscribers. Fewer views than silver, more love than anyone.

And the world tour isn't over. Next stop: Africa. The link is in the description and in the playlist. Now it's your turn: which video should have made this countdown? Tell us in the comments with the hashtag Top10RS. Links to every original video are in the description: go support the creators. Subscribe and hit the bell. A new Top 10 every Sunday.
